rationale: Identity: the held original (60 FR 11011, Feb. 24, 1995) is Executive Order 12952, Amendment to Executive Order No. 12950. Its whole operative text is one sentence that adds the International Brotherhood of Firemen & Oilers to the list of labor organizations attached to EO 12950. That is a self-executing insertion, complete on signing, with no continuing command; the own-text record re-derives from the frozen original. Under the strike-and-insert ruling the inserted name lives in EO 12950 (whose held text sets a 30-day report and termination of the board on its report), not in this order. No held later instrument names 12952, and none of the three searches has a hit. Provisional no rests on the order's own terms and is supported.
